content: The sentiment analysis model that is trained on English reviews has two bidirectional layers, each with 40 neurons and a dropout BIBREF21 of 0.2 is used. The training phase takes pre-trained word embeddings and reviews in textual format, then predicts the polarity of the reviews. For this study, an embedding length of 100 is used (i.e., each word is represented by a vector of length 100). We utilized pre-trained global vectors BIBREF22 . The training phase is depicted in Figure FIGREF2 .
